verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no severity or confidence levels to filter or gate on. Gitleaks does offer other ways to keep noise from failing builds: per-rule allowlists that drop false positives, a baseline that ignores old findings so reports only contain new issues, and composite rules that require auxiliary matches. These cover the goal of the story but not its stated mechanism. Missing for 10: severity or confidence fields on findings, a CLI or action flag to filter or fail by severity or confidence threshold, and independent corroboration.
